script_text: Leo, the cosmos is about to ignite a fire under your throne you did not see coming. Mid-week, the turning point arrives as Venus sextiles Neptune in your 8th House Thursday, softening debts and intimate bonds through graceful negotiation. Late week, Mars trines Pluto in your 5th House of romance Friday through Sunday, fueling passionate love confessions and a weekend creative surge—your bold element of Fire burns bright. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 5th House of love. Sunday is your worst day because Sun-Uranus tension lingers in career. Channel Sun-ruled confidence: sign contracts only after Thursday’s aspect clears. Follow for daily updates.
